verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only per-item APIs: uploads, shared links, collaborations, metadata, search, AI, webhooks and events. Nothing describes a batch or bulk endpoint, or the ability to act on many items in one operation. The passing mention of metadata 'cascade policies' and 'queries' is not explained as a bulk-operation capability, so it is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
